meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a site tour (/website-to-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本转为无人物讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn articles or notes into video content quickly.

howto.what: 将任意文字（文章、笔记、主题等）转化为无真人出镜的解说视频。视频画面由系统自动生成，包括文字排版、抽象图形、图表和数据可视化，无需录制屏幕或实拍素材。
howto.when: 当你提供一段需要解说的文字，并希望将其制作成教学、概念解析、操作指南或列表类视频时触发。不适用于产品推广或网站导览。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成解说视频。
say.note: 系统会引导你确认视频模式、角度、时长和画幅比例。

say.text: 将这段笔记变成3分钟的概念讲解视频。
say.note: 系统会分析内容，规划故事板并生成画面。

say.text: 用协作模式把这份教程做成短视频，发到抖音。
say.note: 协作模式下你会参与关键选择，最终输出竖版视频。

howto.what_en: Turn any text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video. The system generates visuals automatically, including typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, and data visualizations—no screen recording or real footage needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text to explain and want a video for teaching, concept breakdown, how-to, or listicle. Not for product promos or site tours.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video.
say_en.note: The system will guide you through mode, angle, length, and aspect ratio.

say_en.text: Make a 3-minute concept explainer from these notes.
say_en.note: The system analyzes content, plans a storyboard, and generates visuals.

say_en.text: Use collaborative mode to turn this tutorial into a short video for TikTok.
say_en.note: In collaborative mode you help make key choices; output is vertical.
